## About The Pull Request

Closes #91542
More of an oversight than a bug but I agree with the reporter that generally speaking we probably don't want maintenance animals to be dense

I also gave them passtable simply because that's vaguely standard on small animals and I feel like both creatures could easily mount a table

In the same PR I also made some really tiny adjustments to the snail sprite to make its shell rounder because I thought it looked a little too diagonal when I spawned it to test my changes

Additionally I have toned down the shaking caused by stoats being inside disposals because it was a little too extreme and moved all of the code to `disposal bin` rather than `disposals parent object` because half of it was there already and it doesn't work inside a chute
Finally, I implemented the unused `ANIMAL_SHAKE_CHANCE` define because I think the fact that it went unused was largely the cause of the extreme animation as the duration was longer than the process tick time and it was probably stacking on itself

## Why It's Good For The Game

It's annoying to run through maintenance tunnels and have your path blocked by an animal shorter than your ankle
The shaking animation was way too strong

## Changelog

:cl:
qol: You can walk through stoats and snails
balance: Stoats and snails can climb tables
image: Stoats inside disposals are a little less rowdy
image: Snails are rounder

author: saif-ellafi
body:
Hello,

Not sure whether this came out recently due to another change, or if thus far I could not notice this before, but requesting access to the stream to list devices in **Linux** locks the stream and causes the library to fail, yielding: `Bad state: Stream has already been listened to.` after subsequent creation of `AudioRecorder` instances.

This PR fixes this so the stream is broadcasted per request and is not locked to a single call.

Without this PR, in the current state of the library, the recording in Linux only works for the first instantiation of AudioRecorder, but fails with subsequent ones (or multiple recorders or listeners!).

Best regards
Saif

SIGTERM is the standard signal to politely tell a running program to terminate.

Now, the broker always performs a graceful shutdown upon receiving these signals. This behavior now aligns with the intended use of these signals.

The library is opinionated about which ORT settings it exposes, such as the EPs it allows and which options are passed to them. This PR allows library users to provide their own ORT session through the existing config dictionary instead, giving more flexibility. It should not have any effect on existing usage.

This does mean that you have to use the underlying `TextDetector` classes etc. instead of `RapidOCR` in order to use this feature, since the latter assumes YAML configuration. This is okay in my use-case, but it may be useful to consider how to make code-based configuration easier out-of-the-box.

Creates or modifies stream templates in manifest-only connectors.

**PolkaRTC** is a Rust-based Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU) tailored for the Polkadot ecosystem, enabling secure and decentralized real-time communication. ## Summary

Summary about this PR

This pull request introduces support for Move smart contracts, including new transaction types, enhanced blockchain processing, and additional dependencies. It also refactors and extends existing modules to integrate Move contract functionality. Below are the most important changes grouped by theme:

### Move Smart Contract Support

* Added `TransactionType` and `ContractTransaction` enums to represent Move contract operations in `Transaction` struct. Introduced methods like `new_contract_deployment` and `new_contract_call` to create contract-related transactions (`monaos/mona-blockchain/src/block.rs`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-90c3ca8ed221b6650d205762e4ea66f176ca809a3d0fbcbf953ef957c479548cR8-R27) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-90c3ca8ed221b6650d205762e4ea66f176ca809a3d0fbcbf953ef957c479548cR39-R45) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-90c3ca8ed221b6650d205762e4ea66f176ca809a3d0fbcbf953ef957c479548cR132-R211)
* Implemented contract transaction processing in `BlockchainData`, including execution of contract deployment and function calls using `MonaVM`. Added `ContractExecutionResult` and `ContractEvent` to capture execution outcomes (`monaos/mona-blockchain/src/blockchain.rs`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-81e4520266ec43c9d9f335bdbd5e4d60b7800baa9a6c746a2730ef5713c60301R111-R255) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-81e4520266ec43c9d9f335bdbd5e4d60b7800baa9a6c746a2730ef5713c60301R634-R654)

### RPC Enhancements

* Introduced `move_contracts` module and registered Move contract RPC methods in the RPC server. Added dependencies like `jsonrpc-derive` and `blake3` to support Move contract operations (`crates/rpc/rpc-api/src/lib.rs`, `crates/rpc/rpc-api/Cargo.toml`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-f48ee4b802334b05806cb89de801acfa656105c5bc53c28eaaef853ef96f883eR11) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-f48ee4b802334b05806cb89de801acfa656105c5bc53c28eaaef853ef96f883eR23) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-f48ee4b802334b05806cb89de801acfa656105c5bc53c28eaaef853ef96f883eR72-R77) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-40ae7a35a54832a89aa55984d05eb3d47164051bff51db5894a934de6c0de941R42-R45)

### Storage Extensions

* Added `smart_contract` module to `mona-storage`, enabling storage of Move contract metadata, execution traces, and gas usage records. Exposed related types for external use (`monaos/mona-storage/src/lib.rs`).

### Dependency Updates

* Updated `mona-blockchain` and `mona-crypto` to support the `blake3` hashing feature. Added internal dependencies for `mona-vm` and `mona-storage` to enable Move contract execution (`monaos/mona-blockchain/Cargo.toml`, `monaos/mona-crypto/src/lib.rs`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-861b9ac0a6943d431bed6549eb3ea9b2ba63fa146a845b2994b7d6da2f89e0baR42-R45) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-861b9ac0a6943d431bed6549eb3ea9b2ba63fa146a845b2994b7d6da2f89e0baL57) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-2865b9f02ce222b694a38c898bb59104e6ccdced657a0efea90d033224ed1966L102-R113)

### Miscellaneous

* Added a `zero` method to `Address` in `mona-types` for consistency with existing constants (`monaos/mona-types/src/address.rs`).
